summary: The PR addresses handling signed bytes from OPeNDAP via pydap but introduces some issues related to test adequacy and potential behavioral regression.

issues.description: There are no additional tests provided to verify the new functionality, which increases the risk of regressions and ensures the fix works as intended.

The change might introduce behavioral regression if datasets with `_Unsigned=False` attribute are not correctly handled by other parts of the codebase, especially when converting between different engines.
